title: Asshaam Asshaam
body:
ASH- SHAAM,,   ASH- SHAAM,, ASH- SHAAM
MINHAAL TADAPTE HUE SAJJAD asws., SE BOLA.
MOULA MERA DIL PHAT-TA HAI MAT ROYIYE ITNA
MOULA NE KAHA ROU'N MAI MINHAAL NA KYUNKAR.
AANKHO'N SE MERI SHAAM KA MANZAR NAHI JAATA.
SAYYAD E SAJJAD KE HONTO PE THA...
GHURBATE SAJJAD KA HAI MARSIYA...
1. EHLE HARAM NARGA E AGHYAAR MEIN.
BINTE ALI SHAAM KE BAZAR MEIN*2
SAATH MEIN MAI BHI THA WAHI PAR KHADA....
ASH-Shaaa.,.....
<<DIVIDER>>
2. MAINE HAR EK GAAM MASAYEB SAHE.
MERI SAKINA KO TAMACHE LAGE*
BHAYI THA MAJBOOR NA KUCH KAR SAKA...
<<DIVIDER>>
3. NAIZE PE SAR ASGHAR E BESHEER KA.
DIL PE MERE CHALTA HUA TEER THA*2
NAIZE PE PHIRTA RAHA BHAYI MERA...
<<DIVIDER>>
4. HAKIM E BADBAQT RUKA HI NAHI.
MARTA THA SHEH KE LABO'N PAR CHADI.
DEKH KE ABBAS asws., KA SAR RO PADA..
<<DIVIDER>>
5. USKO KANEEZI MEIN JO MAANGA GAYA.
THI YEH SAKINA KE LABO'N PAR SADA*
AAO MADAD KE LIYE AAO CHACHA
Az: MEER KUMAIL ALI
